**Calculating distances**

I need to compare two sets of coordinates: C77 (1.170, -10.326, -4.422) and C36 (.244, -9.783, -2.710). The differences between them are .926, -.543, and -1.712. When I square those differences and add them up — .857 + .295 + 2.931 — I get 4.083. Taking the square root gives me around 2.02. So it looks like C36 is the one I'm focusing on.
